_comment_about_this_file: This is the contacts data file for Noah Wyatt's contact page. Edit this file on GitHub and the contact page will update within minutes. Fields: title (page heading), subtitle (small text under title), links[] (array of contact cards). Each link supports: name (required), url (required), hover_text (optional, shown under name), photo (optional, full URL to image). If photo is omitted, a beautiful Art Deco card is shown automatically.
title: Let's Connect
subtitle: Pick your lane — every door is open.
